skill.name: soultrace
skill.description: Guides users through the SoulTrace adaptive personality assessment and returns a color-based archetype using the SoulTrace API.
skill.summary: Run a 24-question SoulTrace personality assessment and summarize the resulting archetype.
skill.author: soultrace-ai

security_audit.summary: The command findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences and API examples, not executable code in the skill. The hardcoded SoulTrace endpoint is real network behavior, and the skill transmits personality answers to a third-party service. No prompt injection text was found.

remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy notice before starting. Describe data sent, result URL behavior, retention, and user consent.
Document expected network calls and failure behavior. Let users stop before transmitting assessment answers.
Clarify that curl blocks are examples. Prefer approved HTTP tools instead of shell commands when agents call the API.

content.value_statement: Personality tests require consistent scoring and question flow. SoulTrace guides a 24-question adaptive assessment and returns a color-based archetype through its API.
actual_capabilities: Starts a SoulTrace assessment through the documented API endpoint.
Presents each 1-7 Likert question and waits for the user response.
Maps simple descriptive answers to the numeric score scale.
Sends accumulated answers so the API can select the next question.
Summarizes the final archetype, color distribution, top matches, and result link.
Explains rate limits and common API error responses.
limitations: Requires access to the external soultrace.app API.
Sends assessment answers to a third-party service.
Does not provide clinical, medical, or mental health diagnosis.
A full test needs 25 API requests and may hit rate limits.

use_cases.title: Personal Self-Reflection
use_cases.description: Take a guided assessment and receive a structured summary of your SoulTrace archetype.

use_cases.title: Coaching Session Warmup
use_cases.description: Run a consistent questionnaire before discussing communication patterns, strengths, and growth areas.

use_cases.title: Product Research Demo
use_cases.description: Demonstrate an adaptive assessment flow that selects questions and reports a final profile.

prompt_templates.title: Start My Assessment
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a guided personality test.
prompt_templates.prompt: Start a SoulTrace personality assessment for me. Ask one question at a time and wait for my answer.

prompt_templates.title: Explain My Scores
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants a plain-language result summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the SoulTrace assessment and explain my archetype, color distribution, top matches, and result link in simple language.

prompt_templates.title: Support Descriptive Answers
prompt_templates.scenario: User may answer with words instead of numbers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through SoulTrace. If I answer in words, map my response to the 1-7 scale before continuing.

prompt_templates.title: Facilitate a Complete Session
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced guided session with careful consent and final synthesis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a complete SoulTrace session. Confirm I agree to send answers to SoulTrace, collect all responses, and summarize practical reflection points.

output_examples.input: I want to take the SoulTrace test.
output_examples.output: The assistant starts the assessment, asks the first question, explains the 1-7 scale, and waits for a single answer.

output_examples.input: I finished all questions. What does my result mean?
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes the archetype, alignment score, color percentages, top matches, and full results link.

output_examples.input: I answer yes, no, or sometimes instead of numbers.
output_examples.output: The assistant maps each descriptive answer to the closest score and asks for confirmation when the meaning is unclear.

best_practices: Tell users that answers are sent to soultrace.app before starting.
Ask one question at a time and wait for a clear answer.
Present results as self-reflection, not diagnosis or professional advice.
anti_patterns: Do not answer questions for the user or skip required questions.
Do not hide that the assessment uses an external API.
Do not treat the archetype as clinical or employment advice.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides a SoulTrace personality assessment and summarizes the final color-based archetype.

faq.question: Does it require an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses the SoulTrace API at soultrace.app to select questions and return results.

faq.question: How many questions are in the assessment?
faq.answer: The assessment uses 24 questions, plus one initial API request to start the session.

faq.question: Can I answer with words instead of numbers?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill maps simple descriptive answers to the 1-7 scale when possible.

faq.question: Is this a medical or clinical test?
faq.answer: No. The results are for self-reflection and should not replace professional advice.

faq.question: What should I know about privacy?
faq.answer: Your answers are sent to soultrace.app. Review the service privacy terms before sharing sensitive information.
